name: hivemind
description: Opt-in plugin: orchestrate opencode workers from Claude Code to cut token costs. Claude Code plans, reviews and merges; opencode runs single workers or parallel swarms (scout/coder/tester) on free or open-source models with worktree isolation. Requires the third-party opencode CLI and account, and by default worker prompts and code are sent to opencode's hosted service; point --model at a local model to keep code on your machine. Not part of any domain bundle; install it only if you want that data flow.
